title: Stormtrooper
caption: Stormtrooper (V)
game_text: _When drawn for weapon or battle destiny, destiny +2._ While present at a site and armed with a blaster rifle, forfeit +2 and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: One of countless elite shock troops totally loyal to the Emperor. Unquestioningly follow orders. Willing to sacrifice their lives to accomplish a mission. First-strike forces.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique (no dot). First sentence of the slip text ('When drawn for weapon or battle destiny, destiny +2.') is printed in italics. Third stat box on the slip is printed blank (no label). Icon column: one warrior icon (blue square with blaster rifle). No scomp ring. Lore corrected from scan (three wiki errors): 'One of countless' (wiki 'One of the countless'), 'Unquestioningly follow orders' (wiki 'follows'), 'First-strike forces.' (wiki 'force'). Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright year 1995 (Premiere), not legible. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1-D-stormtrooper-pre.gif, 350 px) — used as modern (V4 Stormtrooper Patrol is a different card).
